stanford_cs231n_training.title: Neural Networks Part 3: Learning and Evaluation

shared_changes.description: In the Gradient descent excerpt, qualify basin confinement and momentum crossing claims, and clarify that random initialization serves neural-network symmetry rather than defining generic gradient descent. The opened Goodfellow *Deep Learning* Ch. 4 §4.3 pp. 82–85 and Ch. 8 §§8.1.3, 8.2, 8.3.1–8.3.2 support update, rate and minibatch claims; Lemaréchal 2012 pp. 251–253 supports Cauchy history. Preserve original algorithm, 0.1 rate, [-0.5,0.5] start and XOR exercises; inspect dependent gradient/basic-learning/backprop pages.
